news.headline: FO reiterates Pakistan's 'firm and unshakeable' commitment to Saudi Arabia's security after Riyadh attack
news.summary:

news.headline: At least 139 migrants dead, including some children, after boat from Djibouti to Yemen capsizes, UN agency says
news.summary:
<p>At least 139 migrants, including at least 15 children, have died and around 84 are missing after a boat carrying more than 300 people capsized while sailing from Djibouti to Yemen, the United Nations’ International Organisation for Migration (IOM) said on Sunday.</p>
